summary.text: Liz Campos is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 119 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as Elizabeth Campos, a legislative staffer.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth Campos, who is also known as Liz, has worked as a legal administrator and as a chief of staff in the Texas State Senate.
Campos assumed office in the Texas House on January 12, 2021, succeeding Roland Gutierrez, a Democrat.
In 2023 and 2024 she was assigned to the Human Services Committee, the Public Health Committee (as vice chair) and the Redistricting Committee.
